newsitem.title: USA: Negotiated muni sales total $301 mln for Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Negotiated muni sales total $301 mln for Wednesday.

text.p: Scheduled negotiated municipal bond sales are expected to total $301 million in eight offerings Wednesday, according to Reuters Municipal Bond Information Group.
The largest issue is a $120.6 million North Carolina Medical Care Facilities Authority issue through Smith Barney Inc.

An additional two negotiated deals totaling $8.3 million are on the possible calendar, meaning underwriters have said they may price the issues Wednesday depending on market conditions. --U.S. Municipal Information Group, 212-859-1826
